These macrogroups belong to several divisions within the IVC/EcoVeg classification hierarchy:

```{r}
library(dplyr)
options(knitr.kable.NA = '')
here::i_am("websrc/continental/1.B.3/mcdg-list.qmd")
load(here::here("Rdata/20150130_EcoVeg_hierarchy.rda"))
load(here::here("Rdata/20181123_MacrogroupsCountry.rda"))
dcdgs <- Macrogroups.Global |> filter(IVC.formation == "1.B.3") |> 
  group_by(code = IVC.division) |>
  summarise(`Nr. of Macrogroups` = n_distinct(IVC.macrogroup_key))

EcoVeg_typology_hierarchy |> 
  filter(code %in% c('1','1.B','1.B.3',dcdgs$code)) |> 
  left_join(dcdgs, by = "code") |>
  select(level, name, `Nr. of Macrogroups`) |>
  knitr::kable()
```
